source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 14 exercise solved (PDF 42-44): MCQ keys, model answers and step-by-step numericals; the printed numerical answers checked (14.4 corrected).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Simple Harmonic Motion) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer: (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
14.1 While determining time period of simple pendulum, we keep the amplitude:
(Simple pendulum ka time period maloom karte waqt hum amplitude kaisa rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pendulum sirf chhote angle par S.H.M karta hai, jahan sin θ ≈ θ aur a = −(g/ℓ)x. Is liye amplitude chhota rakha jata hai. Zero amplitude par to pendulum hilega hi nahi.

blocks.prompt:
14.2 In simple harmonic motion, the acceleration of a body is zero, when:
(S.H.M mein jism ka acceleration kab zero hota hai?)

options.text: jab velocity aur displacement dono zero hon
jab velocity aur displacement dono maximum hon

blocks.explanation: S.H.M mein a = −ω²x. Mean position par x = 0, is liye a = 0 (aur wahan velocity maximum hoti hai).

blocks.prompt:
14.3 If a tunnel is bored through the centre of Earth and a stone is dropped into it, then:
(Agar Earth ke centre se guzarti surang (tunnel) khodi jaye aur us mein pathar giraya jaye, to:)

options.text: pathar Earth ke centre par ruk jayega
pathar surang ke doosri taraf se bahar nikal jayega

blocks.explanation: Earth ke andar pathar par gravity ki force centre se us ke faasle ke mutabiq (proportional) hoti hai aur hamesha centre ki taraf hoti hai (F ∝ −x). Yeh S.H.M wali restoring force hai, is liye pathar centre ke aas paas surang ke dono siron ke darmiyan oscillate karta hai (hawa ki rukawat na ho to).

blocks.prompt:
14.4 Which of the following variables has zero value at the extreme position in S.H.M?
(S.H.M mein extreme position par in mein se kis ki value zero hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: v = ω√(x₀² − x²). Extreme position par x = x₀, is liye speed zero hoti hai; wahan displacement aur acceleration maximum hote hain aur ω constant rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.5 Which of the following force is responsible for S.H.M?
(S.H.M ki zimmedar kaun si force hai?)
blocks.explanation: S.H.M restoring force se paida hoti hai jo displacement ke proportional aur mean position ki taraf hoti hai (F = −kx). (Elastic force restoring force ki sirf ek misal hai; aam jawab restoring force hai.)

blocks.prompt:
14.6 The velocity of a particle moving with S.H.M at the mean position is:
(S.H.M karte particle ki velocity mean position par kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mean position par x = 0, is liye v = ω√(x₀² − 0) = x₀ω, yani maximum velocity.

blocks.prompt:
14.7 A child swinging on a swing in sitting position, stands up, then time period of the swing will:
(Jhoole par baitha bacha jhoolte hue khara ho jaye to jhoole ka time period:)
blocks.explanation: Khare hone se bache ka centre of mass oopar chala jata hai, is liye jhoole ki effective length (asal lambai) ℓ kam ho jati hai. T = 2π√(ℓ/g) hai, is liye time period kam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.8 The total energy of a particle executing S.H.M is proportional to:
(S.H.M karte particle ki total energy kis ke proportional hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Total energy T.E = ½kx₀² = ½mω²x₀², is liye yeh amplitude ke square ke proportional hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.9 The period of simple pendulum increases how many times if its length is doubled?
(Simple pendulum ki length double karne se us ka period kitne guna barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = 2π√(ℓ/g), yani T ∝ √ℓ. ℓ′ = 2ℓ ho to T′ = 2π√(2ℓ/g) = √2 T, yani period √2 (taqreeban 1.41) guna ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.1 Define simple harmonic motion and write its equation.
Simple harmonic motion ki definition likhein aur us ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Simple harmonic motion woh aage peeche ki harkat hai jis mein jism ka acceleration mean position se us ke displacement ke seedha proportional ho aur hamesha mean position ki taraf ho.
Equation: a ∝ −x, ya a = −ω²x (mass-spring system ke liye a = −(k/m)x).

blocks.prompt:
14.2 State the basic conditions for frictionless system to execute simple harmonic motion.
Friction ke baghair system ke S.H.M karne ki bunyadi sharait (conditions) bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Restoring force honi chahiye jo displacement ke seedha proportional ho aur mean position ki taraf ho (Hooke's law, F = −kx).
2. Is tarah acceleration displacement ke proportional aur us ke ulat ho (a ∝ −x).
3. Jism mein inertia (mass) ho, taake woh mean position se aage nikal jaye aur oscillate karta rahe.

blocks.prompt:
14.3 Differentiate between free and forced oscillations.
Free aur forced oscillations mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Free oscillations jism ki apni natural frequency par baghair bahar ki force ke hoti hain; forced oscillations bahar ki periodic (driving) force ke zor par hoti hain.

rows: Ek dafa hila kar chhor dein to jism baghair bahar ki force ke oscillate karta hai
Jism bahar ki periodic (driving) force ke zor par oscillate karta hai
Frequency jism ki apni natural frequency hoti hai
Frequency driving force ki frequency hoti hai
Ideal haalat mein energy aur amplitude constant rehte hain
Amplitude driving force par munhasir hai; resonance par bohat bara ho jata hai
Misal: simple pendulum ko hila kar chhor dena
Misal: jhoole ko baar baar dhakka dena; machinon se factory ka farsh hilna

blocks.prompt:
14.4 Why we cannot construct an ideal simple pendulum? Explain briefly.
Hum ideal simple pendulum kyun nahi bana sakte? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Ideal simple pendulum ke liye bob ek nuqta (point mass) ho, dhaga bilkul be-wazan aur na khinchne wala (inextensible) ho, support rigid aur friction ke baghair ho aur hawa ki rukawat na ho. Asal mein bob ka size hota hai, har dhage ka kuch wazan hota hai aur woh khinchta hai, aur hawa aur friction hamesha hote hain, is liye ideal pendulum nahi ban sakta.

blocks.prompt:
14.5 How does sharpness of resonance occur?
Resonance ki sharpness (tezi) kaise paida hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Resonance ki sharpness damping par munhasir hai. Damping kam ho to amplitude sirf natural frequency ke qareeb tezi se bohat bara ho jata hai, is liye resonance curve nokeela (sharp) hota hai. Zyada damping se amplitude chhota aur curve chapta (flat) hota hai (pith ball aur lead bob ka tajurba).

blocks.prompt:
14.6 What would happen to the time period if the Earth suddenly stop rotating?
Agar Earth achanak ghoomna band kar de to time period ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Earth ke ghoomne ki wajah se gravity ka kuch hissa centripetal force deta hai, is liye effective g thora kam hota hai (poles ke ilawa). Agar ghoomna ruk jaye to poles ke ilawa har jagah g thora barh jayega, is liye pendulum ka time period T = 2π√(ℓ/g) thora kam ho jayega (poles par koi farq nahi).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yeh baat chapter se thori aage ki hai: ghoomti Earth par cheez ko gol ghumane ke liye gravity ka thora hissa kharch hota hai, is liye mehsoos hone wala g kam hota hai. Ghoomna band = g zyada = pendulum tez = time period kam.

blocks.prompt:
14.7 What is restoring force? What provides restoring force for simple harmonic oscillator in the following cases? (i) Simple pendulum (ii) Spring
Restoring force kya hai? Neeche diye gaye cases mein simple harmonic oscillator ko restoring force kaun deta hai? (i) Simple pendulum (ii) Spring
blocks.explanation:
Restoring force woh force hai jo hilaye gaye jism par hamesha us ki mean position ki taraf lagti hai (F = −kx).
(i) Simple pendulum: bob ke weight ka raste ke saath wala hissa (component), F = −mg sin θ.
(ii) Spring: khinche ya dabaye gaye spring ki elastic force, F = −kx.

blocks.prompt:
14.8 What role do shock observers play in oscillations of vehicles in a bumpy road? Explain briefly.
Ubar khabar (bumpy) sarak par gaari ke oscillations mein shock absorbers kya kirdar ada karte hain? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Bumpy sarak par gaari ke springs oscillate karne lagte hain. Shock absorbers in oscillations ko damp (kam) karte hain: oscillation ki energy ko heat mein badal dete hain, is liye jhatke jaldi khatam ho jate hain (taqreeban critical damping) aur musafiron ka safar aaram deh hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.1 Why marching troops are asked to break their steps while crossing a bridge? Explain.
Pul (bridge) paar karte waqt march karte fauji dasto ko qadam torne ka kyun kaha jata hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Ek saath qadam milane se pul par qadmon ki frequency wali periodic force lagti hai. Agar yeh frequency pul ki natural frequency ke barabar ho jaye to resonance hoti hai: pul bohat bare amplitude se hilne lagta hai aur gir sakta hai. Qadam torne se force be-tarteeb ho jati hai aur resonance nahi banti.

blocks.prompt:
14.2 A girl is swinging in the sitting position. Describe, how will the period of swing be changed if she stands up?
Ek larki jhoole par baith kar jhool rahi hai. Agar woh khari ho jaye to jhoole ka period kaise badlega?
blocks.explanation: Jhoola simple pendulum ki tarah hai, T = 2π√(ℓ/g), jahan ℓ support se centre of mass tak ka faasla hai. Khare hone par us ka centre of mass oopar chala jata hai, is liye ℓ kam ho jati hai. Is liye jhoole ka time period kam ho jata hai (jhoola tez jhoolta hai).

blocks.prompt:
14.3 Will a pendulum that keeps correct time at Karachi, be accurate at Murree or at the top of mount Everest? Explain.
Jo pendulum Karachi mein theek waqt batata hai, kya woh Murree ya Mount Everest ki choti par bhi durust rahega? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. T = 2π√(ℓ/g). Karachi sea level par hai; Murree aur Everest ki choti bohat oonchi hain jahan Earth ke centre se faasla zyada aur g kam hota hai. Kam g se time period lamba ho jata hai, is liye pendulum din mein kam oscillations karta hai aur ghari sust (peeche) ho jati hai, sab se zyada Everest par. Theek karne ke liye us ki length chhoti karni hogi.

blocks.prompt:
14.4 A wire hangs from a dark high tower so that its upper end is not visible. How can we determine the length of a tower?
Ek oonche andhere minar (tower) se taar latki hai aur us ka oopar wala sira nazar nahi aata. Hum tower ki length kaise maloom kar sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Taar ke neeche wale sire par ek chhota bhari bob baandh dein, yun yeh simple pendulum ban jata hai. Ise chhote amplitude se hilayein aur stopwatch se time period T napein (maslan 20 vibrations ka waqt le kar 20 se taqseem karein). Phir
ℓ = gT²/4π²
Pendulum ki yeh length (support se bob tak) tower ki oonchai hai; bob ki zameen se thori oonchai is mein jor dein.

blocks.prompt:
14.5 Will the period of a vibrating spring increase, decrease or remain constant by addition of more mass? Explain.
Kya zyada mass lagane se vibrating spring ka period barhega, kam hoga ya wahi rahega? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Barhega. Mass-spring system ke liye T = 2π√(m/k), yani T ∝ √m. Mass barhane se inertia barhta hai jabke spring constant k wahi rehta hai, is liye system aahista oscillate karta hai. Maslan mass chaar guna karne se period do guna ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.6 Can a simple pendulum vibrate at centre of the the Earth? Explain.
Kya simple pendulum Earth ke centre par vibrate kar sakta hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Earth ke centre par g = 0 hota hai, is liye bob ka wazan nahi hota aur koi restoring force nahi hoti (mg sin θ = 0). T = 2π√(ℓ/g) se T infinite (la-mehdood) ho jata hai, yani pendulum bilkul oscillate nahi karta.

blocks.prompt:
14.1 Show that motion of mass attached to spring executes S.H.M. Also find an expression for its time period and frequency.
Sabit karein ke spring se bandha mass S.H.M karta hai. Us ke time period aur frequency ki expression bhi maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Mass m ka jism, spring constant k wale spring se, hamwar (smooth) horizontal satah par bandha hai. Us ki aaram wali jagah O mean position hai.
Jism ko x displacement tak kheenchein. Hooke's law ke mutabiq lagai gayi force F = kx.
Spring barabar aur ulti restoring force se wapas kheenchta hai:
F = −kx ...(1)
Chhorne par jism O ki taraf jata hai, inertia ki wajah se O se aage nikal kar spring dabata hai aur dono extreme positions ke darmiyan oscillate karta hai.
Newton ke doosre qanoon se:
F = ma ...(2)
(1) aur (2) ka muqabla:
ma = −kx
a = −(k/m)x
k/m constant hai, is liye a = −(constant)x, yani a ∝ −x.
Acceleration displacement ke proportional aur hamesha mean position ki taraf hai, is liye harkat S.H.M hai.
Time period aur frequency:
a = −(k/m)x ko a = −ω²x se milayein:
ω² = k/m, yani ω = √(k/m)
ω = 2πf se:
f = ω/2π = (1/2π)√(k/m)
T = 1/f = 2π√(m/k)
Yani mass barhe to period barhta hai, aur sakht (stiff) spring se period kam hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ke text mein aakhri line T = 2π√(k/m) chhapi hai; sahi T = 2π√(m/k) hai kyun ke T, f ka ulat (reciprocal) hai. Exam mein T = 2π√(m/k) hi likhein.

blocks.prompt:
14.2 Show that motion of the projection of a particle moving around a circle with constant speed is S.H.M and derive a relation for its instantaneous velocity.
Sabit karein ke daire (circle) mein yaksan (constant) speed se ghoomte particle ki projection S.H.M karti hai, aur us ki instantaneous velocity ka relation nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Particle P radius x₀ ke daire par yaksan angular velocity ω se ghoomta hai. Q us ki projection (diameter AB par perpendicular ka paaon) hai; Q centre O ke aas paas AB par aage peeche harkat karta hai.
t = 0 par A se shuru karein to t waqt mein angle θ = ωt.
Displacement: triangle POQ mein OQ/OP = cos θ, is liye
x = x₀ cos θ = x₀ cos ωt
Acceleration: P ka centripetal acceleration aₚ = x₀ω² centre ki taraf hai. Q ka acceleration is ka diameter ke saath wala hissa hai:
a = −aₚ cos θ = −x₀ω²(x/x₀)
a = −ω²x
ω constant hai, is liye a ∝ −x: Q ka acceleration displacement ke proportional aur O ki taraf hai. Is liye projection S.H.M karti hai.
Instantaneous velocity: P ki speed vₚ = x₀ω tangent ke saath hai. Q ki velocity vₚ ka diameter ke parallel hissa hai:
v = vₚ cos(90° − θ) = x₀ω sin θ = x₀ω sin ωt
sin θ = √(1 − cos²θ) aur cos θ = x/x₀ se:
v = x₀ω√(1 − x²/x₀²)
v = ω√(x₀² − x²) = √((k/m)(x₀² − x²))
Mean position (x = 0) par v_max = x₀ω; extreme position (x = x₀) par v = 0.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Saaye (shadow) wali misal: ghoomti plate ke kinare par gend ho aur roshni us ka saaya deewar par daale, to gend daire mein ghoomti hai magar saaya seedhi line par aage peeche S.H.M karta hai. Kitab ki Eq. 14.13 mein x₀ ka square aur x² chhapne se reh gaye hain; sahi shakal v = ω√(x₀² − x²) hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.3 What is a simple pendulum? Show that motion of a simple pendulum is S.H.M. Also derive an expression for time period of a simple pendulum, on what factors does it depend?
Simple pendulum kya hai? Sabit karein ke simple pendulum ki harkat S.H.M hai. Us ke time period ki expression nikalein; yeh kin cheezon par munhasir hai?
blocks.explanation:
Simple pendulum: mass m ka chhota bhari bob jo halke aur na khinchne wale (inextensible) dhage (length ℓ) se rigid support se latka ho.
S.H.M ka saboot: bob ko chhote angle θ tak hila kar chhor dein. Us ka weight mg do hisson mein: mg cos θ (dhage ke saath, tension se barabar) aur mg sin θ (raste ke saath, mean position ki taraf). Is liye restoring force
F = −mg sin θ
Newton ke doosre qanoon F = ma se
ma = −mg sin θ, a = −g sin θ
Chhote angle par sin θ ≈ θ (radian mein):
a = −gθ
θ = S/ℓ, aur chhote angle par arc S ≈ displacement x:
a = −(g/ℓ)x
Ek pendulum aur ek jagah ke liye g/ℓ constant hai, is liye a ∝ −x. Yani simple pendulum ki harkat S.H.M hai.
Time period: a = −(g/ℓ)x ko a = −ω²x se milayein:
ω² = g/ℓ, ω = √(g/ℓ)
f = ω/2π = (1/2π)√(g/ℓ)
T = 1/f = 2π√(ℓ/g)
Factors (asar daalne wali cheezein): T, √ℓ ke seedha proportional aur √g ke ulat (inversely) proportional hai. Yeh bob ke mass par munhasir nahi, aur na amplitude par (jab tak amplitude chhota ho).

blocks.prompt:
14.4 Derive expressions for K.E. and P.E. of the mass-spring system executing S.H.M. Also prove that its total energy remains same.
S.H.M karte mass-spring system ki K.E. aur P.E. ki expressions nikalein. Yeh bhi sabit karein ke us ki total energy wahi rehti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Potential energy: spring ko 0 se x tak kheenchne mein force 0 se kx tak barhti hai, is liye average force
F_av = (0 + kx)/2 = ½kx
Work = F_av × x = ½kx × x = ½kx²
Yeh work elastic potential energy ki shakal mein jama hota hai:
P.E. = ½kx²
Mean position par yeh zero aur extreme positions par maximum, ½kx₀², hoti hai.
Kinetic energy: instantaneous velocity v = ω√(x₀² − x²) aur ω² = k/m, is liye
v² = (k/m)(x₀² − x²)
K.E. = ½mv² = ½m(k/m)(x₀² − x²)
K.E. = ½k(x₀² − x²)
Yeh mean position par maximum, ½kx₀², aur extreme positions par zero hoti hai.
Total energy:
T.E. = K.E. + P.E. = ½k(x₀² − x²) + ½kx²
T.E. = ½kx₀²
k aur x₀ constant hain, is liye har displacement par total energy wahi rehti hai: energy K.E. se P.E. aur wapas badalti rehti hai magar dono ka jor (sum) mehfooz (conserved) rehta hai. k = mω² se T.E. = ½mω²x₀², yani amplitude ke square ke proportional.
Graph: x (−x₀ se +x₀) ke muqable mein P.E. oopar khulne wala parabola (x = 0 par zero), K.E. ulta parabola (x = 0 par maximum, ±x₀ par zero) aur T.E. ½kx₀² par seedhi horizontal line hoti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asaan tasawwur: extreme position par jism ruka hua hai, sari energy spring mein (P.E.); mean position par spring dheela hai, sari energy harkat mein (K.E.). Beech mein dono ka hissa hota hai, magar jor hamesha ½kx₀² hi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.5 Explain resonance. Give some of its advantages and disadvantages.
Resonance ki wazahat karein. Is ke kuch faide aur nuqsanaat bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Resonance: jab kisi oscillating jism par periodic driving force lage aur us ki frequency jism ki natural frequency ke barabar (ya us ka poora multiple, fₙ = nf₁) ho, to jism sab se zyada energy leta hai aur bohat bare amplitude se vibrate karta hai. Ise resonance kehte hain.
Tajurba: ek horizontal rod se pendulums A, B (length ℓ₁) aur C, D (length ℓ₂) latke hain. Driving pendulum P (length ℓ₁) hilayein; A aur B (wahi length, wahi natural frequency) bare amplitude se jhoolte hain jabke C aur D mushkil se hilte hain. P ki length ℓ₂ karein to C aur D resonate karte hain.
Resonance ki sharpness damping par munhasir hai: kam damping se bara aur nokeela peak.
Faide (kaam ki resonance):
1. Microwave oven: microwaves khane ke paani ke molecules ko usi frequency par hilati hain; un ke takrane se heat bani aur khana pakta hai.
2. Radio tuning: knob ghumane se receiver circuit ki natural frequency station ki frequency ke barabar ki jati hai; phir woh station saaf sunai deta hai.
3. Musical instruments: piano, violin aur guitar ke sound board taaron ke saath resonate kar ke awaz buland karte hain.
4. Standing waves ke tajurbe: Rubens tube, Chladni plate aur acoustic levitation.
Nuqsanaat (jis resonance se bachna hai):
1. Pul (bridges): qadam mila kar march karte fauji pul ko resonance mein hila kar gira sakte hain; Tacoma Narrows Bridge (1940) hawa ki resonance se toot gaya.
2. Hawai jahaz ke par (wings): engine ki vibration, turbulence ya hawa ki forces ki frequency wings ki natural frequency se mil jaye to resonance unhein nuqsan de sakti hai.
3. Imaratein: zalzale ki waves imaraton ko resonance mein la kar gira sakti hain (maslan 2005 ka Azad Jammu o Kashmir ka zalzala).

blocks.prompt:
14.6 Discuss physical significance of phase in simple harmonic motion, and explain how does it relate to timing and synchronization of oscillation?
S.H.M mein phase ki physical ahmiyat par baat karein, aur bataein ke yeh oscillation ki timing aur synchronization (hum-aahangi) se kaise juri hai?
blocks.explanation:
Phase: x = x₀ cos(ωt + φ) mein angle (ωt + φ) harkat ka phase hai; φ phase constant (phase angle) hai, jo t = 0 par displacement aur velocity se tay hota hai.
Physical ahmiyat:
1. Phase kisi bhi lamhe par oscillator ki haalat (state of motion) batata hai: us ka displacement aur harkat ki simt (direction) dono. Do lamhe jin mein displacement ek jaisa ho magar simt ulti ho, un ke phase alag hote hain.
2. Maslan φ = 0 par jism phase 0, π aur 2π par extreme position par, aur π/2 aur 3π/2 par mean position par hota hai.
Timing se talluq:
3. Ek time period T mein phase 2π barhta hai, is liye phase difference Δφ ka matlab time ka farq Δt = (Δφ/2π) × T. Maslan Δφ = 90° ka matlab ek oscillator doosre se T/4 aage hai.
Synchronization se talluq:
4. Phase difference 0° ya 360° ho to oscillators in phase hain: extreme aur mean positions par ek saath pohanchte hain (hum-aahang).
5. Phase difference 180° ho to out of phase: ek +x₀ par to doosra −x₀ par.
6. φ = 0°, 90° aur 180° ke x-t graphs ek hi curve hain jo waqt mein 0, T/4 aur T/2 khiske hue hain.
7. S.H.M mein velocity displacement se π/2 aage hoti hai, aur acceleration displacement ke ulat hota hai (phase difference π).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Do jhoole socho: agar dono ek saath aage jayen aur ek saath peeche, to woh in phase hain (0°). Agar ek aage ho jab doosra peeche, to out of phase (180°). Phase batata hai ke cycle ka kaunsa hissa chal raha hai, jaise ghari ki sui batati hai ke din ka kaunsa waqt hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.1 A body is executing S.H.M of amplitude 0.05 m and frequency 10 Hz. Find the value of (a) acceleration (b) velocity. (Ans: 197 m s⁻², 3.14 m s⁻¹)
Ek jism 0.05 m amplitude aur 10 Hz frequency se S.H.M kar raha hai. (a) acceleration (b) velocity ki value maloom karein. (maximum values)
blocks.explanation:
Given (diya gaya): x₀ = 0.05 m, f = 10 Hz
Required (maloom karna): (a) maximum acceleration a_max, (b) maximum velocity v_max
ω = 2πf = 2 × 3.14 × 10 = 62.8 rad s⁻¹
(a) a_max = ω²x₀ (extreme position par)
a_max = (62.8 rad s⁻¹)² × 0.05 m
a_max = 3948 × 0.05 = 197 m s⁻²
(b) v_max = ωx₀ (mean position par)
v_max = 62.8 rad s⁻¹ × 0.05 m
v_max = 3.14 m s⁻¹
Jawab: a_max = 197 m s⁻², v_max = 3.14 m s⁻¹ (kitab ke jawab se milta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sawal mein sirf "acceleration" aur "velocity" likha hai; S.H.M mein yeh har lamhe badalte hain, is liye yahan un ki maximum values maloom ki gayi hain: acceleration extreme par aur velocity mean position par maximum hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
14.2 A mass of 0.5 kg is suspended from a spring. The spring is stretched 0.098 m. Find: (i) the period of oscillation of mass when it is given a small displacement. (ii) frequency of oscillation of spring. (Ans: 0.628 s, 1.59 Hz)
0.5 kg ka mass spring se latkaya gaya; spring 0.098 m khinch gaya. (i) thora hilane par mass ki oscillation ka period (ii) oscillation ki frequency maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 0.5 kg, x = 0.098 m, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Required: (i) T, (ii) f
Balance (equilibrium) mein spring ki force weight ke barabar: kx = mg
k = mg/x = (0.5 kg × 9.8 m s⁻²)/0.098 m = 50 N m⁻¹
(i) T = 2π√(m/k)
T = 2 × 3.14 × √(0.5 kg / 50 N m⁻¹)
T = 6.28 × √0.01 = 6.28 × 0.1
T = 0.628 s
(ii) f = 1/T = 1/0.628 s
f = 1.59 Hz
Jawab: T = 0.628 s, f = 1.59 Hz (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
14.3 A ball of mass 0.5 kg is attached to an elastic spring. The spring is compressed by 10 cm by a force of 45 N. Calculate the energy stored in the spring. What will be the maximum velocity of the ball if the compressing force is suddenly removed? (Ans: 2.25 J, 3 m s⁻¹)
0.5 kg ki gend elastic spring se bandhi hai. 45 N force se spring 10 cm dabaya gaya. Spring mein jama energy maloom karein. Agar dabane wali force achanak hata di jaye to gend ki maximum velocity kya hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 0.5 kg, x = 10 cm = 0.10 m, F = 45 N
Required: jama P.E., v_max
k = F/x = 45 N / 0.10 m = 450 N m⁻¹
P.E. = ½kx²
P.E. = ½ × 450 N m⁻¹ × (0.10 m)²
P.E. = 225 × 0.01 = 2.25 J
Force hatane par yeh sari P.E. mean position par K.E. ban jati hai:
½mv_max² = 2.25 J
v_max² = (2 × 2.25 J)/0.5 kg = 9 m² s⁻²
v_max = 3 m s⁻¹
Jawab: 2.25 J, 3 m s⁻¹ (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
14.4 A 80 kg body executes S.H.M with amplitude 30 cm. The restoring force is 60 N, when the displacement is 30 cm. Find: (i) time period (ii) acceleration, Speed, K.E. and P.E. when displacement is 12 cm. (Ans: 1.3 s, 3.0 m s⁻², 1.4 m s⁻¹, 7.6 J, 1.44 J)
80 kg ka jism 30 cm amplitude se S.H.M karta hai. 30 cm displacement par restoring force 60 N hai. (i) time period (ii) 12 cm displacement par acceleration, speed, K.E. aur P.E. maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 80 kg, x₀ = 30 cm = 0.30 m, x = 0.30 m par F = 60 N, x = 12 cm = 0.12 m
Required: (i) T, (ii) x = 0.12 m par a, v, K.E., P.E.
k = F/x = 60 N / 0.30 m = 200 N m⁻¹
ω = √(k/m) = √(200/80) = √2.5 = 1.58 rad s⁻¹
(i) T = 2π√(m/k) = 2 × 3.14 × √(80 kg / 200 N m⁻¹)
T = 6.28 × √0.4 = 6.28 × 0.632
T = 3.97 s
(ii) Acceleration (miqdar): a = ω²x = (k/m)x = 2.5 s⁻² × 0.12 m
a = 0.30 m s⁻² (mean position ki taraf)
Speed: v = ω√(x₀² − x²) = 1.58 × √((0.30)² − (0.12)²)
v = 1.58 × √(0.09 − 0.0144) = 1.58 × √0.0756 = 1.58 × 0.275
v = 0.43 m s⁻¹
K.E. = ½k(x₀² − x²) = ½ × 200 × 0.0756
K.E. = 7.56 J ≈ 7.6 J
P.E. = ½kx² = ½ × 200 × (0.12)²
P.E. = 1.44 J
Check: K.E. + P.E. = 9.0 J = ½kx₀² = ½ × 200 × 0.09.
Jawab: T = 3.97 s; a = 0.30 m s⁻², v = 0.43 m s⁻¹, K.E. = 7.6 J, P.E. = 1.44 J. (Kitab ki K.E. aur P.E. theek hain; T, a aur v nahi; neeche box dekhein.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab jawab 1.3 s, 3.0 m s⁻² aur 1.4 m s⁻¹ chhapti hai. Yeh 8 kg mass se bante hain (T = 2π√(8/200) = 1.26 s, a = 25 × 0.12 = 3.0 m s⁻², v = 5 × 0.275 = 1.4 m s⁻¹), sawal mein chhape 80 kg se nahi. 80 kg se: T = 3.97 s, a = 0.30 m s⁻², v = 0.43 m s⁻¹. K.E. = 7.6 J aur P.E. = 1.44 J mass par munhasir nahi, is liye theek hain.

blocks.prompt:
14.5 What should be the length of a simple pendulum whose time period is one second? What is its frequency? (Ans: 0.25 m, 1 Hz)
Jis simple pendulum ka time period ek second ho us ki length kitni honi chahiye? Us ki frequency kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: T = 1 s, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Required: ℓ, f
T = 2π√(ℓ/g)
Dono taraf square: T² = 4π²ℓ/g
ℓ = gT²/4π²
ℓ = (9.8 m s⁻² × (1 s)²)/(4 × (3.14)²)
ℓ = 9.8/39.4 = 0.248 m ≈ 0.25 m
f = 1/T = 1/1 s = 1 Hz
Jawab: ℓ ≈ 0.25 m, f = 1 Hz (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
14.6 A block of mass 5 Kg is dropped from a height of 0.8 m onto a spring of spring constant 1960 N m⁻¹. Find the displacement through which the spring will be compressed. (Ans: 0.2 m)
5 kg ka block 0.8 m ki oonchai se 1960 N m⁻¹ spring constant wale spring par giraya jata hai. Spring kitna dabega (compress hoga)?
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 5 kg, h = 0.8 m, k = 1960 N m⁻¹, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Required: compression (dabao) x
Block ki gravitational P.E. ka nuqsan spring ki elastic P.E. ban jata hai:
mgh = ½kx²
5 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² × 0.8 m = ½ × 1960 N m⁻¹ × x²
39.2 J = 980 x²
x² = 39.2/980 = 0.04 m²
x = 0.2 m
Jawab: x = 0.2 m (kitab se milta hai).
Note: yahan kitab ki tarah h ko poora girna mana gaya hai. Agar spring dabate waqt block ka mazeed x girna bhi gina jaye to mg(h + x) = ½kx² se 980x² − 49x − 39.2 = 0, yani x ≈ 0.23 m.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Energy ka hisaab: oopar se girte block ki height wali energy (mgh) spring mein dab kar jama ho jati hai (½kx²). Dono barabar rakh kar x nikal aata hai.

items: Numerical 14.4 mein kitab ke T, a aur v (1.3 s, 3.0 m s⁻², 1.4 m s⁻¹) 8 kg se bante hain; 80 kg se sahi jawab 3.97 s, 0.30 m s⁻², 0.43 m s⁻¹ hain ("Kitab ki ghalti" box).
Baqi sab numericals ke jawab kitab se milte hain; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
